data.name: Areeqa
data.gender_notes: Areeqa is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who is delightful, pleasing, and beautiful. Derived from the Arabic word 'ar-ra'iqah' which means delightful, pleasing, or beautiful. The name Areeqa carries the meaning “Delightful, Pleasing” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Areeqa usually hope their child will grow to embody delightful, pleasing and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that signifies inner beauty and grace, reflecting the divine nature of the child. It is believed that those named Areeqa possess a gentle and pleasing disposition, which attracts others towards them.
data.etymology: Areeqa belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Delightful, Pleasing.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Areeqa total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: عريقة
in_arabic.meaning: اسم يدل على الرفعة و العلو في الشأن

in_urdu.name: عریقة
in_urdu.meaning: وہ نام جو رفعت اور شان میں اضافہ کرتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: عریقة ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے رفعت اور شان میں اضافہ، یہ نام عربی جڑوں سے ماخوذ ہے اور اس کا تعلق عَرَقَ سے ہے جس کا مطلب ہے بلند ہونا یا اونچا ہونا۔

in_hindi.name: अरीक़ा
in_hindi.meaning: यह नाम प्रतिष्ठा और महत्व को बढ़ाता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: अरीक़ा एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है प्रतिष्ठा और महत्व को बढ़ाना, यह नाम अरबी मूल से निकला है और इसका संबंध عَرَقَ से है जिसका अर्थ है ऊंचाई या उच्चतम होना।

in_pashto.name: عریقة
